title: Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #81 December 1985 Comic Book - Sacred Wars - Dave Sim
descriptionText: The Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #81 December 1985 Comic Book by Dave Sim is a vintage collectible from the Copper Age of US Comics. This single issue features the character Cerebus in a fantasy and comedy storyline, exploring themes of metamorphosis and identity. With its black and white style and first printing features, this comic book from the United States is a must-have for fans of Classic Comics and Dave Sim's unique blend of humor and whimsy.
